name: Ratatouille
description: generates configuration and content recipes easily.
project_description:
Ratatouille is a Drupal module that provides a simple wizard to export reusable Drupal Recipes from your site’s existing content and configuration. It helps you capture structures and settings so you can easily share, replicate, or bootstrap new projects.

 This module is currently under development and may be unstable. Proceed with caution. 

 
 Key features: 

 
 Step-by-step wizard: guides you through recipe creation with a clean and simple interface. 
 Automated dependency scanning: thanks to Drupal’s dependency system, the module automatically discovers and includes all required modules, configuration, and assets. 
 Content & configuration detection: detects content types, fields, taxonomies, media, and other configuration items to include in your recipe. 
 Reusable, standards-compliant output: generates recipes following Drupal’s official format, ready to be used in installers and workflows. 
 
 Use cases: 

 
 Package and share features or sections of your site with teammates. 
 Bootstrap new Drupal projects with a pre-configured starting point. 
 Reuse site elements across multiple projects or distributions.
